description: Source code for CKEditor HTML parser's BasicWriter class, which provides methods to generate HTML content programmatically.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.basicWriter
classes.description: A class for writing HTML elements, attributes, text, comments, and managing output buffer.

methods.description: Constructor function initializing the output buffer.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Writes the opening part of an HTML tag.

methods.name: openTagClose
methods.description: Writes the closing part of an opening tag, handling self-closing tags.

methods.name: attribute
methods.description: Writes an attribute for an HTML tag, with proper encoding.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes arbitrary data to the output buffer.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTML content, optionally resetting the buffer.
